email-recovery-attempts: Tshivhalo tshihulwanesa tsha ndingedzo dzo dovhololwaho
email-recovery-busy: U rumela kana muṅwe mushumo wa mutevhe zwi khou bvela phanḓa. Khwinifhadzani ni lingedze hafhu nga murahu ha tshifhinganyana.
email-recovery-cancel: Khanselani milaedza i re kha mutevhe

email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khanselani milaedza yoṱhe i re kha mutevhe zwino ya muṱanganedzi uyu? Zwi re khayo zwi ḓo bviswa nahone a zwi koni u vhuyedzedzwa. Milaedza miswa yo sikwaho nga murahu ha khumbelo iyi i ḓo vhulungwa.
email-recovery-description: Muduba muthihi kha muṱanganedzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Ṱoḓani nga ID ya mushumisi. Zwi re kha milaedza na zwipiḓa zwa imeyili ya muṱanganedzi a zwi sumbedzwi. U imisa lwa tshifhinganyana hu fara milaedza i re hone na ine ya ḓo ḓa; u isa phanḓa hu lingedza u rumela milaedza ya mutevhe zwino. U khansela hu bvisa milaedza yo dzheniswaho kha mutevhe u swika tshifhingani tsha khumbelo. Arali u rumela hu tshi khou bvela phanḓa, lingedzani hafhu nga murahu ha tshifhinganyana. Mulaedza wo no thomaho u rumelwa a u koni u humiselwa murahu, nahone u rumela hu sa khwaṱhisedzwaho hu nga dovhololwa. U kundelwa ha tshoṱhe na milaedza yo swikaho kha tshivhalo tsha ndingedzo tsho vhewaho zwi dzula zwo vhulungwa u itela u ṱoliwa. U lingedza hafhu milaedza yo kundelwaho hu thoma mutevhe muswa wa ndingedzo nahone hu vhulunga u imiswa lwa tshifhinganyana hu re hone.
email-recovery-empty: A hu na milaedza kha mutevhe kana vhaṱanganedzi vhe u rumelwa havho ha imiswa lwa tshifhinganyana.
email-recovery-failed: Mushumo a wo ngo kona u khwaṱhisedzwa. Khwinifhadzani mutevhe ni lingedze hafhu mushumo wonoyo arali zwi tshi ṱoḓea.
email-recovery-oldest: U dzheniswa ha u thoma kha mutevhe
email-recovery-pending: Zwo lindela kana zwi khou lingedzwa hafhu
email-recovery-retrying: Milaedza ine ya khou lingedzwa hafhu
email-recovery-saving: Hu khou khwinifhadzwa mutevhe wa dzi-imeyili…
email-recovery-superseded: Mushumo muswa wa mulanguli wo dzhiela khumbelo iyi vhudzulo. Hu sumbedzwa tshiimo tsha mutevhe tsha zwino.
email-recovery-unavailable: A zwi konadzei u vhala mutevhe wa dzi-imeyili. Ṱolani thendelo ya mulanguli na u wanala ha seva.
